disabled-binding:
Disabled Binding

IsDisabledOneWayStatePath blocks pointer events and raises the opacity while the path is truthy.

Usage 

@uiForm.SearchableSelectInput(uiForm.SearchableSelectInputSettings{
	InputName:                 "country",
	Label:                     "Country",
	FlatOptions:               []string{"Argentina", "Brazil", "Chile"},
	TwoWayStatePath:           "country",
	IsDisabledOneWayStatePath: "isDisabled",
})

dropdown-height:
Dropdown Height

DropdownMinHeightClass and DropdownMaxHeightClass cap the option list. MaxVisibleOptions caps it to a row count and wins over both.

Usage 

@uiForm.SearchableSelectInput(uiForm.SearchableSelectInputSettings{
	InputName: "country",
	Label:     "Country",

	// OptionalFields
	FlatOptions:            []string{"Argentina", "Australia", "Brazil", "Canada", "Chile", "China", "France", "Germany", "India", "Japan", "Mexico", "Portugal"},
	TwoWayStatePath:        "country",
	DropdownMinHeightClass: "min-h-24",
	DropdownMaxHeightClass: "max-h-40",
	MaxVisibleOptions:      3,
})

labelvalueoptions:
LabelValueOptions

LabelValueOptions store one value while showing another label, and filter on the label. LabelHtml replaces the row content with custom markup.

Usage 

@uiForm.SearchableSelectInput(uiForm.SearchableSelectInputSettings{
	InputName: "countryCode",
	Label:     "Country",

	// OptionalFields
	LabelValueOptions: []uiForm.SelectLabelValueOption{
		{Label: "Argentina", Value: "AR"},
		{Label: "Brazil", Value: "BR"},
		{Label: "Chile", Value: "CL"},
	},
	TwoWayStatePath: "country",
})

multi-select:
Multi-Select

IsMultiSelect binds an array and keeps the dropdown open after each toggle. The trigger shows the selected labels, and the clear button empties the array.

Usage 

@uiForm.SearchableSelectInput(uiForm.SearchableSelectInputSettings{
	InputName: "countries",
	Label:     "Countries",

	// OptionalFields
	FlatOptions:     []string{"Argentina", "Australia", "Brazil", "Canada", "Chile", "China", "France", "Germany", "India", "Japan", "Mexico", "Portugal"},
	TwoWayStatePath: "countries",
	IsMultiSelect:   true,
})

selected-as-tags:
Selected as Tags

SelectionDisplay tags renders every selection as a removable tag. ShouldAllowCustomValues turns a typed value into a tag on Enter, and Backspace removes the last tag.

Usage 

@uiForm.SearchableSelectInput(uiForm.SearchableSelectInputSettings{
	InputName: "countries",
	Label:     "Countries",

	// OptionalFields
	FlatOptions:             []string{"Argentina", "Brazil", "Chile"},
	TwoWayStatePath:         "tagCountries",
	IsMultiSelect:           true,
	SelectionDisplay:        uiForm.SearchableSelectInputSelectionDisplayTags,
	ShouldAllowCustomValues: true,
})

tag-colors:
Tag Colors

TagOuterBackgroundColor paints the chip and its border. TagOuterTextColor paints its text, and TagInnerBackgroundColor paints the label bubble.

Usage 

@uiForm.SearchableSelectInput(uiForm.SearchableSelectInputSettings{
	InputName: "countries",
	Label:     "Countries",

	// OptionalFields
	FlatOptions:             []string{"Argentina", "Brazil", "Chile"},
	TwoWayStatePath:         "coloredTagCountries",
	IsMultiSelect:           true,
	SelectionDisplay:        uiForm.SearchableSelectInputSelectionDisplayTags,
	TagOuterBackgroundColor: "primary-500",
	TagOuterTextColor:       "neutral-950",
	TagInnerBackgroundColor: "neutral-50/20",
})
